text_en: Hallo, we are about to launch an all-out attack on your houze.

text_en: What a calm night, Don't you want to have a deathmatch with magic involved?

text_en: Dear alive, we cant fidn the bearded man in your house, so we will atack the whole neighborhod.

text_en: Do you dare resist Dr. Zomboss's requests? Go prepare the water and the brains that I will pierce with my trident.

text_en: We would like to sell these Z-CORP brand umbrellas in exchange of zome brainz. It'z a good deal, isn't it?

text_en: The darkness is the way out.
Join the dark side. We have cookies.

text_en: The Darkness is close. Do you by any chance like the theater?

text_en: This is the end. It is here.
